import json
from driver import run

# slot reuse: floor advance releases seq0's slot; an old up packet for q=0
# must aggregate nothing and produce an unchanged (negative) ACK.
inputs = [[[1],[2],[3],[4]], [[10],[20],[30],[40]]]
events = [
    ["send",0,0], ["send",0,1], ["send",1,0], ["send",1,1],
    ["duplicate",2],            # id4 = copy of up(1,0)
    ["deliver",0],              # aggregate seq0 from rank0
    ["deliver",2],              # aggregate seq0 from rank1 -> full, results
    ["deliver",1], ["deliver",3],
    ["deliver",6], ["deliver",7],           # down rank0/1 seq0 -> results + dacks
    ["deliver",12], ["deliver",13],         # dacks crate floor=1, release seq0
    ["send",0,1], ["send",0,2],             # reuse window
    ["deliver",15],                          # up rank0 seq2 -> entry seq2 in slot 0
    ["deliver",4],                          # OLD up(1,0) -> out of window now
]
req = {"op":"replay","inputs":inputs,"slots":2,"window":2,"events":events}
out,err = run(json.dumps(req))
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
print("created ids:")
ev = out["events"]
# reconstruct creation order -> packet identity
PYEOF
python3 scen1.py
